title: Digital Events: Ops Agent & Logistics Dashboard
problem: Slack-first operations without a single source of truth; fragmented shipping/receiving; limited visibility for samples and equipment.
approach: Hexagonal architecture on Supabase + Neo4j knowledge graph
Slack/Asana/Shippo/Cheqroom ingestion → chunking/metadata → embeddings → RAG insights
Daily Ops Brief, logistics map (people/equipment), event timeline, sample queue, SLA/contract tracking
solution: Unified dashboard and agent that converts unstructured chatter into structured ops signals with KPIs and actions.

outcomes.label: Receiving Time
outcomes.tooltip: Median time from arrival to intake complete

outcomes.tooltip: Increase in structured operations events captured

seo.description: Agent-powered logistics dashboard with graph insights, Daily Ops Brief, and unified shipping/receiving visibility.
